title: Signal & image processing
intro: A progression from orthogonal representations to denoising, inverse problems, and sparse recovery.

decks.title: Overview: a Sparse Tour of Signal Processing
decks.description: An overview of sparse representations and their role in imaging.

decks.title: Signal and Image Processing with Orthogonal Decompositions
decks.description: Represent signals in orthogonal bases and connect coefficients to processing tasks.

decks.title: Fourier Processing
decks.description: Use Fourier representations to understand convolution and frequency filtering.

decks.title: Wavelet Processing
decks.description: Move between scales with wavelets and multiresolution representations.

decks.title: Approximation and Coding with Orthogonal Decompositions
decks.description: Select and encode coefficients for approximation and compression.

decks.title: Linear and Non-linear Denoising
decks.description: Compare linear filters with nonlinear methods for removing noise.

decks.title: Variational Regularization of Inverse Problems
decks.description: Recover images by combining a data term with a regularity penalty.

decks.title: Sparse Regularization of Inverse Problems
decks.description: Use sparsity to reconstruct signals from incomplete or degraded observations.

decks.title: Convex Optimization for Imaging
decks.description: Work with convex objectives and algorithms for imaging problems.

decks.title: Compressed sensing
decks.description: Reconstruct sparse signals from a small number of measurements.

decks.title: Sparse ℓ¹ recovery
decks.description: Understand when ℓ¹ minimization recovers sparse solutions.

title: Geometry & mesh processing
intro: Differential and geodesic tools for understanding, sampling, and processing surfaces.

decks.title: Differential Mesh Processing
decks.description: Study discrete differential operators and smoothing on triangular meshes.

decks.title: Geodesic Mesh Processing
decks.description: Measure distances and compute shortest paths on surfaces.

decks.title: Geodesic Sampling and Meshing
decks.description: Distribute points and construct meshes using geodesic distances.

decks.title: Surface Parameterization
decks.description: Flatten a surface and control the distortion of its planar representation.

decks.title: Active Contours
decks.description: Evolve curves to detect boundaries and segment images.

decks.title: Multiresolution Mesh Processing
decks.description: Represent and process geometry across multiple resolutions.
